'''Escape Bay 14''' was a location on the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Byrt]]'', a civilian vessel in use at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==History==
When the infant [[Ben Skywalker]] was targeted by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agents for abduction during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], one of the major battles of the war, his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] guardian [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] rushed him to safety aboard the ''Byrt''. Pursued by Yuuzhan Vong agents through the passenger liner, C-3PO hid with the infant in Escape Bay 14 while he waited for rescue. When [[Viqi Shesh]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who was collaborating with the Yuuzhan Vong, spotted C-3PO, the droid hid Skywalker in a locker and rushed to one of the bay's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. From inside the escape pod he used his functions as a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to mimic the sound of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] baby crying, causing Shesh and the Yuuzhan Vong to rush into the escape pod. Once the senator and the Yuuzhan Vong were inside, C-3PO was forced back out into the bay, whereupon he launched the escape pod and retrieved Skywalker from the locker.
